from pathlib import Path
import difflib
import hashlib
import subprocess

main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
path = 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/p49-terminal-batch-design-v1.31-FROZEN.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path], cwd=main)
new = (main / path).read_bytes()
old_sha = hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()
new_sha = hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest()
assert old_sha == '7b8531fdd9bcb4b2ecf8f3576eab6285f09f4b22fb1b212775939dbe72d19200'
assert new_sha == 'e9b18793d3fea5755e886d55d0dbebdfc8a5d39374237fe0e05757a242ef6e9a'
old_lines, new_lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True), new.splitlines(keepends=True)
changes = [op for op in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, old_lines, new_lines, autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if op[0] != 'equal']
assert len(changes) == 2
assert all(op[0] == 'insert' for op in changes)
assert changes[0][1:3] == (6, 6)
assert changes[1][1:3] == (len(old_lines), len(old_lines))
print(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--unified=3', '--', path], cwd=main).decode(), end='')
print('OLD_SHA256=' + old_sha)
print('NEW_SHA256=' + new_sha)
print('APPEND_ONLY=PASS additions=' + str(sum(op[4] - op[3] for op in changes)) + ' deletions=0 insert_blocks=2')
